text:
Rina: noticed a spike in 'late_ingest' alerts and a correlated dip in billing-agg totals for 02:15-02:45 UTC (eu cluster). looks like a small but measurable late window. thinking: targeted small-backfill + console diff to validate.
Carlos: agree. prefer conservative path: 1) sample tenants (top 50 by events) 2) dry-run replay, 3) diff, 4) gated non-dry-run. avoids burning quota.
Ethan: quick numbers: raw events for window (eu) ~9,720; expected ~11,000. ~11.6% missing. will post query: `SELECT tenant_id, count(*) FROM events_raw WHERE region='eu' AND ingested_at >= '2026-03-21 02:15' AND ingested_at < '2026-03-21 02:45' GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 50;`
Sara: +1 on sample. also we should use the new replay flag `--ordering-guard` (prevents reordering heuristics) because some of these late messages came in with older timestamps. avoids aggregate churn.
Rina: good call. we should also avoid KV thrash on agg-readers. plan to run at low concurrency and enable `--kv-stagger=100` to spread warmups.
oncall-bot: oncall rotation: sara@example.com (oncall) until 2026-03-22T12:00Z. please @mention for non-dry-run approval.
Carlos: console quota pool for backfills shows `priority-lane` at 8% remaining. we should not touch that. propose using quota tag `ops:ephemeral-4` for this run. ConsoleOps: can you allocate?
ConsoleOps: allocated `ops:ephemeral-4` token for 3 hours. token id=ep4-20260321, limit=20k events. will revoke early if you ask.
Ethan: operator checklist draft: 
- run sample query to pick 50 tenants
- start `replay-cli` dry-run with `--emit-diff --ordering-guard --tenant-list=sample50 --kv-stagger=100`
- wait for diff in console/diffs, run `scripts/diff-assert`
- if pass, escalate to 25% non-dry-run with rate-limit 30rps and token ep4-20260321
- monitor `agg-service` p50/p95 and error-rate
Sara: add `--idempotency-check` after dry-run passes. we discovered last month that some legacy producers rewrite event ids.
Rina: who wants to own the canary dry-run? I can start it if someone watches the console diff.
Carlos: i'll take watch. ping me when job created.
Rina: creating job now -> `replay-cli run --start 2026-03-21T02:15Z --end 2026-03-21T02:45Z --tenant-list=sample50 --dry-run --emit-diff --ordering-guard --kv-stagger=100 --tags=canary-eu-02-15`
oncall-bot: replay job created id=job_20260321_eu_canary, owner=Rina, status=scheduled. console: https://console/internal/replays/job_20260321_eu_canary
Carlos: got it. will watch CPU on agg-worker-*, and memory on redis-cached-agg. if any p95 > 2s, abort.
ConsoleOps: console will create a separate diff view for tag `canary-eu-02-15`. use that to verify tenant-level bumps.
Ethan: dry-run finished: console diff shows +9,680 events matched to raw query. small mismatches on two tenants due to late-timestamp normalization but totals align.
Sara: run `scripts/idempotency-check --job job_20260321_eu_canary` -> returns 0 dupes. good.
Rina: ok approving move to 25% non-dry-run with token ep4-20260321 and `--rate-limit=30rps`. calling @sara for oncall approval.
Sara: approve for 25% non-dry-run with the conditions above. I'll be on pager and watching dashboards for the next 90m.
Rina: launching stage1 non-dry-run. job id=job_20260321_eu_stage1. tags: ["initiator:rina","token:ep4-20260321"]
oncall-bot: job job_20260321_eu_stage1 queued, token=ep4-20260321, rate-limit=30rps. runner=runner-22.
Carlos: progress check after first batch: 22% done, KV miss steady, no increase in agg-service errors. good so far.
Ethan: small anomaly: one tenant shows a -0.6% delta in a secondary metric due to a late merge logic change. not in primary billing count but worth noting. filing follow-up ticket `ENG-telemetry-merge-edge`
Sara: ok to proceed to full window run overnight at lower concurrency. prefer `--rate-limit=15rps` and extend token for 6h. ConsoleOps: can you extend token?
ConsoleOps: extended token ep4-20260321 to 6h and increased event cap to 60k. noted -> follow up ticket for adding 'reserve ephemeral token' checkbox in console UI so operator can reserve without handoffs.
Rina: thanks. lesson: we should have a small-playbook snippet in console called "late-eu-mini-backfill" so engineers can run this flow without ad-hoc chat. I'll add a doc.
Carlos: also let's add a preflight verifier in the replay API that refuses non-dry-run if ordering-guard wasn't exercised in a dry-run. small safety net.
Ethan: agree. filing `replay-api: preflight-require-dryrun` tiny RFC.
Rina: closing thread for now. will post summary and link to postmortem doc after overnight run. :v:"
